routeReason: The market-to-rooftops transition remained a validated player-visible seam defect after two formal repair attempts. Attempt 3 stays in the formal fixer flow because the exact transition branch requires independent natural-input and perceptual QA on desktop and mobile.

priorQaFailure.finding: The opaque v2 bridge still exposed an isolated dark vertical band at the left edge of the transition plate, approximately x=180 in the v2 fixture, with an adjacent-column mean RGB delta of about 21.83.

attemptContinuity.incrementReason: Attempt 2 used an opaque edge-locked 2080x958 bridge with 204px overlap. Attempt 3 preserves the same composition and ownership model, but introduces a real alpha feather so the neighboring market and rooftops plates remain visible through the bridge edges.
attemptContinuity.newRepairHypothesis: The isolated band is caused by the opaque bridge edge being composited above the neighboring panorama. A 256px smoothstep alpha feather on both horizontal edges lets the adjacent opaque plates carry the boundary while the bridge body remains opaque and visually continuous.
attemptContinuity.scopeGuard: No gameplay, save, economy, UI, platform adapter, or longmap topology code was changed.

assetProvenance.relationship: Runtime asset is byte-for-byte the registered v3 feathered candidate. Its RGB pixels match the v2 bridge body; only the alpha channel supplies the horizontal feather.
